slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about lexicographic versus weighted/simultaneous optimization, then followed up in turn 7 to identify the first priority, confirming p1 demand, p2 preferred specialty, and p3 preferred city order.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 priority-order slot and the P1 exact-demand slot before issuing READY_TO_MODEL. Any remaining uncertainty about integrality is outside the listed hidden slots and was explicitly marked as an open assumption.

summary: The agent directly asked about both hidden modeling facts, including exact demand fulfillment and lexicographic priority ordering, and reached READY_TO_MODEL only after those P0/P1 issues were resolved.
